e4.why: E4's best arm: the highest field_dev macro-F1 among arms 1 to 5 that ran (rule configs/e4.json rules.best_arm). The test checks this against E4's records.

settings.note: Copied from configs/e4.json arm convnext_joint and the E4 record's train config. tests/test_e12.py compares every value with E4's; only the extra rows, the output folder and the loader worker count differ.

extra.note: datasets/manifests/extra_train.csv as frozen by T4.5 and T4.8. Rows keep the cap of 200 per class set there; no further cap or filter is applied. A run refuses to start if the manifest's dataset hash differs.

num_workers.note: Set with --num-workers or SPROUT_NUM_WORKERS (the flag wins), default 2, at most 4 (T4.1). E4 ran with 4. The sample order comes from a torch Generator seeded with the run seed, so it does not depend on the count; the random augmentation draws are made inside the workers, seeded from the same generator plus the worker's number, so they do depend on the count, as they did in E4. A resume must use the count the run started with. The count is written to the record.

runs.name: convnext_joint_extra
runs.change: E4 convnext_joint plus the extra_train rows

runs.name: heldout_plantdoc_extra
runs.change: the same without PlantDoc in training or selection (extras that repeat a PlantDoc photo also leave); scored on field_dev PlantDoc

runs.name: heldout_plantseg_extra
runs.change: the same without PlantSeg in training or selection (extras that repeat a PlantSeg photo also leave); scored on field_dev PlantSeg

decision.rule: The extra rows clearly help if both hold. (1) On the seen-source run, scored on field_dev shared_classes+clean:1, the paired 95% interval of the macro-F1 difference (E12 minus E4 convnext_joint) lies wholly above zero. (2) On each held-out-source run, the macro-F1 difference (E12 held-out minus E4 held-out, same rows) is at least minus heldout_margin. Otherwise they do not clearly help, and E4's model stays.
decision.heldout_margin_reason: A fixed allowance of two macro-F1 points on a held-out part of 421 to 619 photos, where a single run's own noise is of that order. The point difference is used, not an interval, because a held-out part this small cannot show a loss that small; the interval is reported beside it.
decision.if_helps: chosen_model is models/e12/convnext_joint_extra/best.pt. E5's calibration and thresholds are refit on it (configs/e5.json points to it); results/e12/decision.json says so.
decision.otherwise: chosen_model stays models/e4/convnext_joint/best.pt and E5 is not refit.

limits: Development numbers on field_dev, which also chose E4's model, so E4's numbers are optimistic and E12's compare on the same footing only because they use the same field_dev rows.
Each model is one run with one seed; the paired interval resamples photos and does not cover run-to-run training noise.
E4 trained on field.csv's rows and E12 does too (the 7 sampled field_train removals of E13 were not applied to training).
